guidelines.title: Python Standards
guidelines.description: Follow Python 3.13+ best practices. Use `uv` for package management and script execution.

guidelines.title: Linting and Formatting
guidelines.description: Use `ruff` for linting and formatting. Configuration is in `pyproject.toml`. Run `make lint` and `make format` or `make fmt` to ensure compliance.

guidelines.title: Type Checking
guidelines.description: Use `pyright` for static type analysis in strict mode. Run `make typecheck` to verify types.

guidelines.title: Testing
guidelines.description: Use `pytest` for testing. All new code should have tests in the `tests/` directory. Run `make test` to execute tests with coverage. Minimum coverage goal is 70% as per `pyproject.toml` comment.

guidelines.title: Workflow
guidelines.description: Use the provided `Makefile` for common tasks: `make check` (lint + typecheck), `make all` (lint + typecheck + test).
